intro: Musquash Root is a rare botanical specimen found only in the damp soil beneath the massive waterfalls of the Stonewrought Dam in the Wetlands. It serves as a vital component in a concoction brewed by cultists hidden beneath Stormwind.

p: Musquash Root thrives in the perpetually mist-soaked ground where the cascade of the Stonewrought Dam crashes into the Wetlands. Its secluded and damp habitat makes it exceedingly difficult to harvest. While ordinary herbalists rarely seek it out, certain practitioners of the darker arts value the root for its potent chemical and alchemical properties.
